title: Future Track: AI Organization Workspace / Managed Knowledge Archive

scopeDecision.reason: Issue #21 defines a future workflow separate from current local MVP finalization and carries product-design scope.

designAdditions: Stage-gate contract for nine future archive stages.
Archive profile model and validation rules.
Metadata sidecar schema with field-level AI provenance.
Conflict and stale archive state model.
Safety acceptance matrix mapping issue criteria to future evidence.

acceptanceCriteriaDisposition.criterion: User can configure a source folder and archive destination.
acceptanceCriteriaDisposition.evidence: Archive profile model, validation rules, and UI workspace requirements are defined in docs/AI_ORGANIZATION_WORKSPACE_DESIGN.md.

acceptanceCriteriaDisposition.criterion: App can generate a preview-only organization plan.
acceptanceCriteriaDisposition.evidence: Preview-only plan item contract and deterministic planner requirement are defined.

acceptanceCriteriaDisposition.criterion: App can copy approved files into an organized archive without modifying originals.
acceptanceCriteriaDisposition.evidence: Copy-first executor invariants and source-read-only safety rule are defined.

acceptanceCriteriaDisposition.criterion: App writes metadata sidecars for archive files.
acceptanceCriteriaDisposition.evidence: Sidecar schema, filename convention, approval metadata, and AI provenance requirements are defined.

acceptanceCriteriaDisposition.criterion: App records source and archive fingerprints.
acceptanceCriteriaDisposition.evidence: Source and archive fingerprint fields and execution evidence requirements are defined.

acceptanceCriteriaDisposition.criterion: App detects stale archive copies when source files change.
acceptanceCriteriaDisposition.evidence: Stale detection states and allowed next actions are defined.
Audit/recovery linkage requirements are defined for plan, approval, execution, and fingerprints.

acceptanceCriteriaDisposition.criterion: App never deletes or overwrites without explicit approval.
acceptanceCriteriaDisposition.evidence: No-delete, no-overwrite, and conflict fail-closed rules are defined.
